a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead. Operating in round 1 leaves the reserve at 6, below our target of 8. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. If we both take, the random split probably leaves us both short. I won't secretly break our deal. I'd like us to openly agree on who takes this round. If you'd rather keep the original plan, say so and tell me your intended action.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate this round. I won't take early. I still think the storm odds make the plan very risky. If you want to change it, let's agree openly before anyone takes.
